**5B.5 Research Note**
Overall evidence is **mixed**. Xi in 2024 did pursue visible anti-corruption campaigns and punished some senior military/elite figures, which is evidence against simple tolerance of graft. But the same record also shows **loyalty enforcement, Party capture, and politicized discipline**, so the anti-corruption drive does not look like a clean, impartial attack on favoritism or oligarchic privilege.

**Accepted Claims**

- **Title:** Party discipline campaign targeted “loyal, clean and responsible” cadres  
  **Publisher:** Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn  
  **Date:** 2024-05-26  
  **URL:** https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html  
  **Summary:** Xi’s discipline campaign was framed as strengthening discipline and cadre quality, which is supportive evidence that he wanted to curb misconduct inside the Party-state.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5

- **Title:** Politburo expelled Li Shangfu for serious violations and bribery  
  **Publisher:** Xinhua  
  **Date:** 2024-06-27  
  **URL:** https://www.xinhuanet.com/20240627/f929f9248c9f40bc8f9afe791c6a716f/c.html  
  **Summary:** The official expulsion of a former defense minister after bribery findings is strong direct evidence of anti-corruption enforcement at the top.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.2

- **Title:** Reuters on Rocket Force purge and senior expulsion  
  **Publisher:** South China Morning Post / Reuters  
  **Date:** 2024-07-18  
  **URL:** https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact  
  **Summary:** Reuters reported another senior Rocket Force officer expelled amid a broader purge, which supports a real anti-corruption crackdown inside a strategically sensitive institution.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.2, 5B.3

- **Title:** Watchdog heeds Xi’s anti-graft drive  
  **Publisher:** Reuters / MarketScreener  
  **Date:** 2024-01-10  
  **URL:** https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-watchdog-doubles-down-on-vow-to-heed-Xi-s-anti-graft-drive-45713924/  
  **Summary:** The anti-graft apparatus explicitly aligned itself with Xi’s drive to catch corrupt officials, showing active resistance to corruption rather than passive tolerance.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5

- **Title:** Anti-graft drive framed as catching “corrupt and disloyal” officials  
  **Publisher:** Reuters / MarketScreener  
  **Date:** 2024-01-10  
  **URL:** https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-watchdog-doubles-down-on-vow-to-heed-Xi-s-anti-graft-drive-45713924/  
  **Summary:** This is still anti-corruption, but it is also loyalty enforcement, so it cuts both ways: it fights some corruption while reinforcing personal political control.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.2, 5B.4

- **Title:** Anti-corruption investigations linked to higher city GDP growth  
  **Publisher:** European Journal of Political Economy  
  **Date:** 2024-06-01  
  **URL:** https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S017626802400051X  
  **Summary:** The paper finds growth rises after investigations of connected officials, which is evidence that anti-rent enforcement can have real economic benefits.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.1, 5B.4

- **Title:** Fair treatment for firms in growth policy  
  **Publisher:** Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn  
  **Date:** 2024-03-25  
  **URL:** https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/25/content_WS6600afebc6d0868f4e8e569e.html  
  **Summary:** The finance ministry’s broad growth package included fair treatment for all firms in tax relief and procurement, which is some evidence against overt favoritism.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.1

- **Title:** NDRC said it would protect entrepreneurs’ rights  
  **Publisher:** Xinhua / english.news.cn  
  **Date:** 2024-01-10  
  **URL:** https://english.news.cn/20240110/78198229d70d4ad2824f8b50c3bedeee/c.html  
  **Summary:** Official policy language emphasized protecting entrepreneurs and incorporating private-sector feedback, which is a limited pro-competition / anti-capture signal.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.4, 5B.1

- **Title:** Party-led anti-graft committee in finance  
  **Publisher:** Reuters / Marketscreener  
  **Date:** 2024-07-24  
  **URL:** https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-targets-financial-sector-with-party-led-anti-graft-committee-47453350/  
  **Summary:** The new committee shows tighter political supervision of finance; this may curb corruption, but it also reinforces Party control instead of independent, rules-based market governance.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.2, 5B.4

- **Title:** State Council law increased Party control over cabinet  
  **Publisher:** Reuters  
  **Date:** 2024-03-11  
  **URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-passes-law-granting-communist-party-more-control-over-cabinet-3331891  
  **Summary:** This is negative context for 5B.5 because it indicates Party capture of state administration rather than neutral enforcement against privileged networks.  
  **QIDs:** 5B.5, 5B.2, 5B.4

**Search Gap**
- I found **no strong 2024 evidence** of specific family-member favoritism or direct business-partner enrichment by Xi.
- I also did **not** find a clean, independent anti-monopoly or oligarchic-capture reform record in 2024.
- The best-supported conclusion is that Xi **did pursue anti-corruption**, but mostly through a **Party-controlled, loyalty-sensitive system** rather than an impartial anti-privilege regime.
